description: This file defines a Java interface 'MappingResultHandler' with generic type parameters, providing method signatures for handling different outcomes of a mapping process in a messaging system. It includes methods for successful message mapping, dropping messages, handling exceptions, combining results, creating empty results, and resolving topic paths.

classes.name: MappingResultHandler
classes.description: A generic interface for handling various outcomes of message mapping processes in a messaging system, supporting multiple invocation and combination of results.

methods.name: onMessageMapped
methods.description: Handles a successfully mapped message, returning a result of type R.

methods.name: onMessageDropped
methods.description: Handles the case where a message should be dropped without producing a result.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during mapping, allowing the handler to process errors.

methods.name: combineResults
methods.description: Combines two results into a single result, useful when a message produces multiple mapping outcomes.

methods.name: emptyResult
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty or default result, serving as an identity element for result combination.

methods.name: onTopicPathResolved
methods.description: Signals successful resolution of a TopicPath, storing it for later retrieval and logging.
